text:
Asha (CS): Quick heads-up: PaperTrail onboarding seeing 429s during their quickstart. Using python sdk v0.10.0 and demo ephemeral tokens. They spin up ~6 test workers. Can someone quick-triage?
Tom (SDK): Likely preflight/auth fanout from per-worker client create. Can you paste a short log?
Asha (CS): Log snippet: 
```
2025-08-12T10:03:01Z INFO worker start
2025-08-12T10:03:01Z DEBUG auth: ephemeral fetch -> 200
2025-08-12T10:03:01Z DEBUG preflight: /v1/preflight -> 200
2025-08-12T10:03:02Z WARN http: 429 Too Many Requests
```
Rex (SE): Region? account? ops-bot can show windows.
Asha (CS): Region us-west-2, account papertrail-staging.
ops-bot: Account windows: preflight=4 req/s, demo_tokens=true.
Tom (SDK): Immediate fix: reuse one client per process, enable HTTP keepalive, add small random jitter (0-250ms) before client init. Also upgrade to v0.10.2 which coalesces preflight.
Asha (CS): Can Eng apply a short bump while they validate? Requesting preflight=8 req/s for 15m.
Rex (SE): Ack. Applying now.
ops-bot: Temporary change applied: preflight=8 req/s for papertrail-staging for 15m.
Asha (CS): Customer applied client reuse and upgraded. They report 429s ceased within 3 minutes during ramp. Will monitor 30m then close. Thanks all :thumbsup:
